verdict.rationale: Homebrew's own source is publicly hosted at github.com/Homebrew/brew, cited directly as a GitHub source. Formula definitions live in a public homebrew-core repository: `brew create` writes `.../homebrew-core/Formula/ffmpeg.rb`, and taps clone public GitHub repos. So the source is clearly readable, but no item in the pack names the license or confirms it is an open-source license. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence (license name or file), first-party statement of open-source status, independent corroboration.
